correctness.rationale: The 14 generator supports are transcribed from the formulas in Section 7 of arXiv:2109.09002v1. A complete minimal-transversal recursion and a separate enumeration of all 27,405 four-subsets agree on exactly 130 minimal covers, all of size four. The stored order passes the pure shelling criterion directly in facet language for every earlier/current pair; every facet therefore has 30-4=26 vertices.
